summary: Disaster Desk long feed: I filled in four topics Studio uses next (Mars Climate Orbiter, Colgan 3407, Lac-Mégantic, Herald of Free Enterprise) with 9 report-sourced facts, a chapter outline and a hook that names the small cause and the toll first, and logged three long-video hook items.
why: Studio needs 4 long videos a week and the feed had 16 open long topics but no outlines and 2-6 facts each. The owner's 22 Nov hook note is backed by the references: the 176x breakout states the outcome by 17 s and the slow openers did 0.57x.

findings.title: Outcome-first hooks win in the references
findings.detail: Fault Lines' Learjet (11K subs, 1.94M views) states the toll at 5-17 s; Plainly Difficult's Kolkata (1.1M subs, 628K) names its subject at 64 s.

findings.title: MCO's 57 km estimate is in the board report
findings.detail: The research note said not to use it; it is on p. 14 of the NASA MIB Phase I report.

findings.title: The Herald's warning was written down in 1985
findings.detail: Sheen report para 18.4-18.5: a master asked for bow-door lights on the bridge; the managers dismissed it.

changes.title: Four long topics enriched
changes.detail: Scout entries override the research feed's with the same ids: outline, 9 facts, search, stakes-first hook, verify notes (Lac-Mégantic names its Short v-20261121-42).

changes.title: Three backlog items
changes.detail: Stakes-first long hook (adopt, script), recipe toll rule (adopt, for the improver), roles not names (adopt, script).
